title: what 30 days of my apps going to sleep at 11pm did to my brain
why: Scrolless shape (96K, 35K saves): the hook names the habit you quit, the app shows up from slide 2 as the method.
caption: willpower got me to night 3. how far would you get? #dopaminedetox #screentime #phoneaddiction #sleep
check: slide 1: '30 nights without tiktok in bed'. Only post after you've actually done 30 nights
slide 2: '14 times the first night'. Use your real count, from Screen Time
slide 3: 'asleep before midnight most nights'. Only if true
slide 5: the moons screenshot shows 14 moons. Say a number that matches your own

slides.title: what 30 nights without tiktok in bed did to my brain

slides.heading: night 1 to 3: _everything is annoying_
slides.top: i opened instagram 14 times the first night and got this _every single time_
slides.text:
the urge isn't for the app

it's for _not being bored_ for four seconds
slides.bottom: this is the part where most people quit. it passes

slides.heading: night 4 to 10: _falling asleep faster_
slides.top: with nothing to scroll, lying in bed gets boring _fast_
slides.text:
boring is the point

i went from "one more video" at 1am to _asleep before midnight_ most nights

slides.heading: day 11 to 20: _mornings start standing up_
slides.top: my apps stay asleep until i've _walked 200 steps_
slides.text:
by the time instagram wakes up, i'm already _out of bed_ with the kettle on

no snooze spiral because there's _nothing to snooze into_

slides.heading: day 21 to 30: _the streak does the work_
slides.top: every morning i get up, i unlock a new moon
slides.text:
it sounds stupid. i'm _not breaking it_

the app isn't asking me to be disciplined. it just _doesn't give me the option_ at 1am

slides.question: willpower got me to night 3. _the lock got me to night 30_
lines: the app is locturne if you want to try it
search Locturne on the App Store
